text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it also takes time. You need to choose a place, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try food you have never eaten before. Sometimes you face language barriers because you don't speak the local language. This can be difficult, but people often help you with smiles and gestures. These moments become special memories that you keep forever. Travelling teaches you about the world and about yourself, and every journey gives you a story to tell your friends and family back home.
